notes: dm_speech=1 means not demonstrated to be non-speech; it is a superset, not a verified exact speech subset
id_session and id_int are stable only within this edition

risks: political opinions in parliamentary speech are sensitive-category personal data under EU data-protection analysis
speaker names and political affiliations appear in metadata columns
speech text may mention third parties and private individuals
minimization_plan: exclude all speaker identity, party, district, sex and stable IDs from exported training text
use id_session only internally for deterministic split grouping; do not export it
exclude PII/contact patterns and corrupted PUA/control-character rows
require human/legal privacy review of text content and processing basis before any admission

known_issues: 1,213 named speech rows are unresolved or ambiguous in speaker linkage; irrelevant if metadata is dropped but signals source extraction limits
required_checks: download exact pinned CSV and verify provider MD5
stream text-only export and count rows
exact and near dedup across all admitted corpora

decision.reason: Strong Spanish parliamentary text source with CC BY 4.0 declaration and a large corpus, but the full 1.06 GB text has not been acquired or scanned. Sensitive political content and third-party mentions require a documented privacy basis and minimization before redistribution or model training.

attribution: Rodrigues-Silveira, Rodrigo (2026). ParlaIbero-ES: Parliamentary Speeches from Spain (1977-2025), version 2.0. Harvard Dataverse. https://doi.org/10.7910/DVN/OKHGAB. CC BY 4.0.
